body.name: Partition-compatible singleton covered reversal
body.construction: For \(i\to j\) in \(G_E\), \(\operatorname{rev}_{i\to j}(E)\) is defined exactly when \(\operatorname{pa}_{G_E}(j)=\operatorname{pa}_{G_E}(i)\cup\{i\}\), \(\{i\}\in\Pi^E_j\), and \(\Pi^E_j\setminus\{\{i\}\}=\Pi^E_i\). It reverses \(i\to j\), sets \(\Pi'_j=\Pi^E_i\) and \(\Pi'_i=\Pi^E_i\cup\{\{j\}\}\), and leaves every other partition unchanged.
